takeaway: Systemic vascular resistance = (MAP − mean right atrial pressure) × 80 / cardiac output. Reference range 800–1200 dynes × sec/cm³.

lines.text: Let's build this equation one piece at a time.
Start with the mean arterial pressure,
and subtract the mean right atrial pressure.
then divide by the cardiac output.
The result is the systemic vascular resistance.
So: the arterial minus right atrial pressure, times 80, divided by cardiac output.
lines.say: So: the arterial minus right atrial pressure, times eighty, divided by cardiac output.
